title: Laminar: A Scalable Asynchronous RL Post-Training Framework
unit: The University of Hong Kong; ByteDance Seed

resources.code: not found on arXiv/EuroSys page as of 2026-07-03

workflow.rollout_unit: complete trajectory generated by one policy version
workflow.trainer_input: completed trajectories sampled from an experience buffer
workflow.algorithm: GRPO with rule-based rewards in the main experiments
workflow.architecture: fully decoupled trainer/rollout with CPU relay workers for asynchronous weight synchronization
workflow.long_tail_mechanism: dynamic repack using KVCache utilization and Best-Fit trajectory consolidation
workflow.staleness_model: per-trajectory inherent staleness rather than configured k-step bound
workflow.not_streaming_rl: does not define streaming video context or sample sealing
